article.title: Digital Health Interventions for Pregnancy- and Childbirth-Related Posttraumatic Stress Disorder Symptoms in Postpartum Women: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
article.authors: Huang Z, Xiao Z, Liao X
article.abstract: Pregnancy- or childbirth-related traumatic experiences may lead to posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) symptoms during the postpartum period, adversely affecting women and their families. Digital health interventions may improve access to psychological support; however, evidence of their effectiveness for pregnancy- and childbirth-related posttraumatic stress disorder (PCR-PTSD) symptoms remains limited and has not been systematically synthesized.
